exact_statement.objects: A arbitrary additive commutative group; I finite; forms_i additive maps A -> Z; c in A; Gamma arbitrary membership predicate
hypotheses: For every q, Gamma(q) implies forms_i(q)>=0 for every i.
For every q, forms_i(q+c)>0 for every i implies Gamma(q).
conclusions: For every q, Gamma(q) iff forms_i(q)>=0 for every i.
For every q, forms_i(q)>0 for every i iff there exists g with Gamma(g) and q=c+g.
Separately, every additive integer form of value one at c is surjective.

hypotheses: Containment of Gamma in the closed halfspaces
Exact shifted lifting for all group elements

decisive_findings.finding: The two exact equivalences follow from integer additivity and subtraction.
decisive_findings.argument: Closed q has strictly positive forms at q+c, so lifts. Strict q has all integer values at least one, so q-c is closed and hence belongs to Gamma. The two reverse implications use containment.

decisive_findings.finding: Height one proves primitivity of an already supplied form.
decisive_findings.argument: Every integer z is form(z times c); no existence or integrality of a geometric facet is inferred.
